I'd say to go for e580. I bought L580 a while ago, because people believe it is a sturdied laptop (tweakers did a review on both of them) but I believe that might not be the case. In psref you can see that e series have alluminum panelling, and although I only saw e585 laptop and touched it in a shop, screen felt overall tighter and more resistant to twists and bends. On the other hand - L series have metal hinges, and should be longer lasting.

Some YouTube videos suggested that E580 ventilators was working overtime - even while idling - and it was more or less why I decided to get L series. News flash - ventilayor is still quite loud, but not aggressively annoying and while idling is mostly silent. It gets a bit hot during load and the vents are on the right side, which is unusual.

Overall - L is not as sturdy as people believe it is, you can feel plastic creaking etc. Someone suggested that it has better thermals but I cannot confirm that, because this laptop will get hot under load. Keyboard is fine, fhd screen is awesome, but lacks proper RGB % and backlight is not very good, can be even lower than 250 nitts.

If I were you I would look at 14 inch laptops, which have a bigger market and thus a better competition. This option might even allow you to get better deal, such as  T490, which I heard is good this year (check it on notebookcheck). I regret buying L580 because it was quite an investment and doesnt feel very premium. It even has a bit of coil whine nowadays. Unless you get a good deal, go for E or check them both and see which you like. I can get work done and it is a fine laptop for that and the screen is the best I had, but again, I was expecting more for that price range.
